title: EXCITED RIDER v11: a free browser motocross game I built with Codex
author: beans_fotos_
selftext:
I wanted that old-school motocross feel in a game you could just open in a browser. That turned into EXCITED RIDER, and v11 is now live and free to play.



Play: [https://excited-rider.beansfotos.chatgpt.site/](https://excited-rider.beansfotos.chatgpt.site/)



This update adds Eliminator, where the last rider gets cut at timed checkpoints; Remix Run, with shareable course codes; and Ride Director, which lets you scrub through a run and save photos or short gameplay clips. The bikes, riders and circuit scenery also got another detail pass.



On the AI development side, I used Codex for the code and iteration. The game is Three.js/TypeScript, with procedural bike and terrain geometry. For this release, the work was split between bikes, environments and modes, with before/after captures at each phase and browser playtests after integration.



The useful lesson was how much a still image misses. Replay footage exposed rocks floating above the updated terrain; backward scrubbing also needed fixes for stale tire trails and rider poses. Those were separate presentation bugs, so we fixed those without changing the recorded race results. The release passed 147 automated checks plus full race and export tests.



The attached image is AI-generated promotional artwork, not a gameplay screenshot. Image generation was also used for some of the game’s visual assets. This has been an iterative build with plenty of corrections along the way.



Go give it a full send!
